page.layout: One page of text, one column of italic verse with a running head above; a title "THEOD" at lower right of the page area. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Argutum aut cuius lector miretur acumen: Vel qui grande sonans, secum super astra legen Attollat, coelique beet Gelut arce receptum: Vel qui non fatuo teretes sale deficet aures, Et cieat torpens moderato ardore palatum: Illimis semper, purāque argenteus Vnda, Nec scopulis horrens Villis, ceu Voluitur amnis, Inuitans, satiánsque sitim potantis abunde: Hic mihi sit Verus, tum re, tum nomine, Vates:
Vos autem Aonidū sanctum temerare pudor Et puros aufi latices turbare petulci, Ingrati procul ite, procul: Vel crimina fasi, Discite Vos casties s̄ Vestra dicare Camœnis.

At Vos, ô rauca stridentes Voce cicada, Vana coaxantes tumido Vos gutture ranæ, Vos fatuo elumbes Vomitantes pectore Verfus, Senfa quibus nec mens, nec Voces suggerit oestri Quis sacro Vatum dignetur nomine sanus?
main_text.head: THEOD

page.notes: Several words are set in a decorative italic with an unusual V-shaped capital glyph read here as V or G; forms such as "Gelut", "Vnda", "Voluitur" are uncertain. The right edge is cut off, so line ends such as "legen", "pudor", "Verfus" and "oestri" may be incomplete. Show-through and stains are not transcribed.
